published_ranges._notes: The official Amazon listings (B07HHKW729, B07DVL9DTD, B07Y3Q5T54) give only diameter/tolerance, 'no heating bed needed', a 1 kg spool with a built-in remaining-filament gauge and a resealable bag. No nozzle temperature, bed temperature, density or drying is published. A third-party Patreon post ('AmazonBasics PETG 3D Printer Filament, 1.75mm, Gray') quotes 'what Amazon thinks PETG should print at' as 230-240 C nozzle and 80 C bed; it is not an Amazon page and is not used. Some colours are listed as currently unavailable.
